extension.valueMarkdown: When a resource has no narrative, only systems that fully understand the data can display the resource to a human safely. Some ecosystems restrict distribution of resources to only those systems that do fully understand the resources, and as a consequence implementers may believe that the narrative is superfluous. However experience shows that such eco-systems often open up to new participants over time.
